title: Cellect SCADA | 팀 PostgreSQL 파일럿
description: 최근 2A 실행을 읽기 전용으로 조회합니다. 수집 전에는 스테이션만 표시될 수 있습니다. 레인별 Buffer는 브리지 협의 항목입니다.

panels.title: 팀 DB 스테이션
panels.description: SSH 터널과 읽기 전용 계정 확인. 접속 검증의 기대값은 전체 라인 23행입니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT station_code AS "스테이션", name AS "이름"
FROM station
ORDER BY sort_order, station_code

panels.title: 최근 2A 실행 수율
panels.description: 가장 최근에 시작한 2A 실행의 팀 DB 수율입니다. 화면 시간 범위와 관계없이 조회합니다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT run_id, purpose, started_at, ended_at
  FROM sim_run
  WHERE line = '2A'
  ORDER BY started_at DESC, run_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT r.run_id AS "실행 ID", r.purpose AS "목적", r.started_at AS "시작",
       y.cells_in AS "투입", y.appearance_ng AS "외관 NG", y.first_pass_ok AS "1차 PASS",
       y.retested AS "재검", y.retest_recovered AS "재검 합격",
       y.removed AS "제거", y.boxed AS "포장 셀"
FROM selected_run r
LEFT JOIN v_run_yield y ON y.run_id = r.run_id

panels.title: OCV 관측값
panels.description: 최근 2A 실행에서 선택 기간의 검사 완료값. 원본 mV를 V로 변환합니다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT run_id, purpose, started_at, ended_at
  FROM sim_run
  WHERE line = '2A'
  ORDER BY started_at DESC, run_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT i.measured_at AS "time", i.station_code, (i.ocv_mv / 1000.0)::double precision AS "OCV"
FROM cell_inspection i
JOIN cell c ON c.cell_id = i.cell_id
JOIN selected_run r ON r.run_id = c.run_id
WHERE i.kind = 'electrical' AND i.ocv_mv IS NOT NULL
  AND i.measured_at >= $__timeFrom() AND i.measured_at < $__timeTo()
ORDER BY i.measured_at, i.id

panels.title: IR 관측값
panels.description: 최근 2A 실행에서 선택 기간의 검사 완료값. 측정 누락은 표시하지 않습니다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT run_id, purpose, started_at, ended_at
  FROM sim_run
  WHERE line = '2A'
  ORDER BY started_at DESC, run_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT i.measured_at AS "time", i.station_code, i.ir_mohm AS "IR"
FROM cell_inspection i
JOIN cell c ON c.cell_id = i.cell_id
JOIN selected_run r ON r.run_id = c.run_id
WHERE i.kind = 'electrical' AND i.ir_mohm IS NOT NULL
  AND i.measured_at >= $__timeFrom() AND i.measured_at < $__timeTo()
ORDER BY i.measured_at, i.id

panels.title: 전기검사 이력
panels.description: 최근 2A 실행과 선택 기간의 최신 검사 시도 200건입니다. 검사 ID로 동시 검사와 재검을 구분합니다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT run_id, purpose, started_at, ended_at
  FROM sim_run
  WHERE line = '2A'
  ORDER BY started_at DESC, run_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT i.id::text AS "검사 ID", i.measured_at AS "측정 시각", i.cell_id AS "Cell ID",
       i.station_code AS "검사기", i.attempt AS "시도",
       (i.ocv_mv / 1000.0)::double precision AS "OCV (V)", i.ir_mohm AS "IR (mΩ)",
       CASE WHEN i.result_code IN (1, 2, 3) THEN 'PASS'
            WHEN i.result_code = 9 THEN 'FAIL'
            WHEN i.result_code = 5 THEN 'PENDING' END AS "시도 결과",
       CASE i.result_code WHEN 1 THEN 'A' WHEN 2 THEN 'B' WHEN 3 THEN 'C' END AS "특성군",
       i.reason_code AS "사유 코드"
FROM cell_inspection i
JOIN cell c ON c.cell_id = i.cell_id
JOIN selected_run r ON r.run_id = c.run_id
WHERE i.kind = 'electrical'
  AND i.measured_at >= $__timeFrom() AND i.measured_at < $__timeTo()
ORDER BY i.measured_at DESC, i.id DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: 완료 Kit
panels.description: 최근 2A 실행에서 선택 기간 내 완료한 박스입니다. 현재 팀 DB의 셀 구성으로 4슬롯과 그룹 일치를 확인합니다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT run_id, purpose, started_at, ended_at
  FROM sim_run
  WHERE line = '2A'
  ORDER BY started_at DESC, run_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT b.box_id AS "Kit ID", b.packed_at AS "완료 시각", b.grade AS "특성군",
       b.status AS "박스 상태", b.cells AS "셀 수",
       (b.spread_mv / 1000.0)::double precision AS "OCV 편차 (V)"
FROM v_box_spread b
JOIN selected_run r ON r.run_id = b.run_id
WHERE b.status IN ('full', 'handed_over', 'consumed') AND b.cells = 4
  AND b.packed_at >= $__timeFrom() AND b.packed_at < $__timeTo()
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cell c
    WHERE c.box_id = b.box_id
      AND (c.grade IS DISTINCT FROM b.grade OR c.run_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.run_id)
  )
ORDER BY b.packed_at DESC, b.box_id
LIMIT 200
